title.narrative: Municipal performance based on grants scheme

description.narrative: This project (Initiation Plan) will support the formulation of a proposal for a forthcoming EU call (scheduled for fall 2024) on strengthening municipal capacities and performance while meeting the expectations of the financial contributors. The preparatory activities supported by this project will help to address the Overall Objective to successfully co-design a municipal performance-based grant scheme for Albanian local governments by adopting best experiences and practices, including fostering gender equality at the local level, and ensuring that the proposal is not only competitive and contextually relevant but also achievable and aligned with the capabilities of local governments and the expectations of the financial contributors .
